_comment: Findings of tools/analysis/process-audit.mjs that are intentional (P8-H1). laser_cooled_ps (2026-11-02): the step is the kept 243 nm cooling laser, which the audit does not count; the lab has no fluid slot. The audit fails only on keys listed in neither list. Remove a key when its finding is fixed. options.ignore: globs of ids the audit skips. Reasons: uncraftable chain_strand_foil and double_chain_strand_plate are the retired CHAIN_UNUSED forms, their recipes removed by opv/cuts.js; trivial_step superfluid_helium_3 and superfluid_helium_4 are phase changes of one fluid (a cooling step, not a process line); trivial_step pathfinder_probe_core is the crafting-table unpack of the launched pathfinder probe (opv/pathfinder.js).
